## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes.

## Validation

List checks actually run, including real JVM/JDK/GC coverage when relevant. Distinguish local execution from checks configured for CI.

## Compatibility and evidence

Note changes to report schemas, metric meaning, supported inputs, permissions, privacy or installation. Parser changes need a failing regression and independently supported expectations. Do not attach production heap dumps, credentials or sensitive recordings.

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change.
- [ ] No diagnostic observation is promoted to an unsupported root-cause claim.
- [ ] Third-party notices and changelog are updated when needed.
